mode.label: Mode
mode.phase2: Arrives in Phase 2, with the time cursor it has to preserve.

map.label: Map of the Gulf of Aqaba: catchments, coastal outlets and reef zones
map.faultTitle: The map cannot render Arabic labels
map.faultBody: The right-to-left text plugin did not load, so Arabic place names would render unshaped and in the wrong order. This is shown rather than hidden, because the failure is otherwise invisible in English.
map.textEquivalent: Everything the map shows is also listed in the side rail: five catchments with their areas, five coastal outlets with their upstream areas, and eight reef zones. The basemap detail stops at 35.0°E, short of the eastern edge of catchment AQ-C01.

rail.label: Layers and values
rail.reefProvisional: Provisional zones. Sensitivity is 1.0 on all eight, pending marine-science review — so exposure varies only through the hazard term, and these zones do not differ in sensitivity.
rail.coverageNote: The dashed boundary is where the OpenStreetMap extract ends, at 35.0°E. Catchment AQ-C01 continues past it — Wadi Yutum drains from 90 km inland — so the absence of detail out there is a gap in the basemap, not empty desert.

time.label: Time
time.phase2: Time slider arrives in Phase 2 and will drive every time-varying layer at once.
time.attribution: Roads, wadis and place names © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

specimen.title: Component specimen
specimen.subtitle: Every component, both themes × both directions. A primitive that is not here has not been checked.
specimen.canaryNote: Each value below must keep its number before its unit, in both directions.
specimen.hazardNote: Every fill carries a 1px stroke at the next band up. A fill alone is not a boundary.
specimen.provenanceNote: Measured, modelled and envelope differ by form, not by hue — so the distinction survives colour-blindness, greyscale and a photograph of the screen.

value.missingLong: No data — this is a gap, not a zero
